blocks.text: SHENZHEN, China—The leaders of China, the United States and Russia exchanged greetings as they met in Shenzhen on Wednesday, a day before their history-making first formal trilateral summit in the Chinese city. The agenda for Thursday’s meeting between presidents Xi Jinping, Donald Trump and Vladimir Putin — which has raised fears of a carve-up into new “spheres of influence” — was unclear, however. When Trump touched down in Shenzhen, Xi became the first Chinese paramount leader in decades to welcome a foreign leader as he arrived, mirroring the US president’s gesture at Joint Base Andrews in September.
